Changed in `scenario.json`:

- Request now reads as user voice rather than stacked schema adjectives: `Move the "Deep Work" focus-time block on Thursday morning on the Engineering calendar — the one with "Sprint Planning" on Thursday afternoon — to Room 5B. I marked it private.` The visibility condition is an afterthought sentence ("I marked it private"), and the anchor is framed as the user's own disambiguation ("the one with..."), which is why a real user with two same-named calendars would write it. Conditions c1/c5 texts updated to match.
- Seed now motivates the duplicated "Engineering" name in the records themselves: active calendar is "Active team calendar", the second is "Old team calendar, kept for reference", and the archive is "Archived copies of team events" (which also explains the shared iCalUID copy there).

Kept: the four decoys and query logic are unchanged — "focus-time block" stays because it is genuine Google Calendar user vocabulary, and the anchor structure is required by the brief's B fact (title + time on one event of the calendar).
